subject: Deploy Candidate 01 reversible four-card mosaic focus
body: Deploy Candidate 01 branch SHA 15528d185eaf52916f8fefff72cc19c6e19cfe97 to the existing local Doré Design resident worktree. This version replaces the independent appearing preview with a reversible four-card shared-image mosaic: four uniform 8:5 cards capture their real rects, assemble into four quadrants of one 8:5 master image, merge, then split and return before drift resumes. Do not alter public homepage.

argv: HTML=$(curl -fsS 'http://127.0.0.1:4310/editor-canvas?page=living-water-candidate-01'); printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'dore-mosaic-piece' && printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'mosaic-assemble' && printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'animatePieces(false)' && ! printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'aspect-ratio:5/8'
